ABOUT AAV WORKS

Engineering
Beyond Tracks

AAV Works Private Limited is a specialised railway S&T design and drawing company focused on delivering reliable, efficient and future-ready solutions for modern rail infrastructure.

We operate across all 18 Indian Railway Zones, leading end-to-end design from Scheme Plans, Table of Control (Selection Tables), and Interface Circuit Design to Independent Verification (Proof Consultancy) and on-site Testing & Commissioning.

OUR PRODUCTS

Tools for a
Smarter Tomorrow

View All Products
High-Speed Interlocking I/O

SENSIO

Robust and high-performance input reading and output delivery to the main electronic interlocking system. Features a rapid 200ms response time and supports inter-cabin Ethernet networking.

  • 448 I/O Functions: Unmatched capacity in a single modular rack.
  • 10A Output Relay Cards: Engineered for heavy point machines and high-thrust signals.
  • Automatic Self-Testing: Built-in algorithms processing live gear automation logic.
AVW_EI_DIAGNOSTIC_CONSOLE // V3.8
ONLINE / SIL-4
> AAV Works Virtual Electronic Interlocking (EI) Engine Ready.
> Zonal Configuration: Indian Railways General & Subsidiary Rules (G&SR)
> Ready to execute Automated Factory Acceptance Test (A-FAT).
Cycle: 200ms • 0 Error Count
Automatic Factory Acceptance Validator

SENTRIS

An intelligent A-FAT validator that tests electronic interlocking data against predefined safety rules, eliminating hundreds of hours of manual verification and human testing error.

  • All 18 Zones Compatible: Accommodates diverse bit nomenclatures and TOC rules.
  • Automated Audit Logs: Generates instant compliance reports for RDSO and CRS inspection.
99.8%
Reduction in Manual Test Hours

SENTRIS validates up to 10,000 interlocking route permutations in under 12 minutes with zero safety oversights.

Interactive Train Simulator

SENS Traffic Simulator

Immersive training software replicating real-life railway station operations for Station Masters and Traffic Controllers. Includes on-screen block instruments and automatic block sections.

  • Fault Injection: Test emergency response during point failures and signal blanking.
  • Comprehensive Trainee Evaluation: Automatic scoring of operating precision and rules.
Station Master Training Console

Provides true-to-life VDU panels, UFSBI block working, and ABS signal aspects for full Indian Railways operational training.

Field GIS & Cable Route Management

SENS Cable Tracker

Tailor-made GIS application designed for the Indian Railways to pinpoint cable initiation, termination, track crossings, and core allocation with millimeter precision.

Trackside GIS Core Mapping

Ensures rapid fault localization during maintenance, cutting cable restoration delays by over 70%.

Automated Logic & Circuit Generation

SENS Algen & L2L

Harnesses predefined railway signalling safety rules to algorithmically generate interlocking circuit diagrams and Boolean logic equations directly from yard layout plans.

Zero-Error Algorithmic Schematics

Generates complete interface circuit sheets, contact analysis tables, and wiring charts without human drafting errors.
